verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented batch or bulk operation, such as a multi-file endpoint, directory-level CLI conversion, or bulk job submission. The CLI examples convert a single file, Pipelines chain processors on a document rather than across many items, and file storage only supports reuse across separate calls. Bulk operations are a fair axis for a document-processing API, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
